title: SB190 (2024 Regular): AN ACT relating to firearms.

provenance.fetched_by: LegiScan bulk data (gun-policy Stage 5, Kentucky); operative text read by a Sonnet fill agent from the official Kentucky text (Introduced, 0000-00-00; official copy, https://apps.legislature.ky.gov/recorddocuments/bill/24RS/sb190/orig_bill.pdf (LegiScan doc 2921896))

operative_text:
Section 2 (new section of KRS Chapter 237): (1) Any person may voluntarily request to be placed on the list established under this section and be restricted from purchasing or possessing firearms.
Section 2 (new section of KRS Chapter 237): (5)(a) Upon receipt of a request from a person seeking inclusion on the list under this section, or from the person's health care provider under Section 3 of this Act, the Department of Kentucky State Police shall add the person to the list and transmit the information to NICS within two (2) business days.
Section 2 (new section of KRS Chapter 237): (6) The Department of Kentucky State Police shall automatically remove a person from the list one hundred eighty (180) days after the person was added to the list, unless the person requests to: (a) Be removed from the list after ninety (90) days; (b) Remain on the list for an additional one hundred eighty (180) days; or (c) Remain on the list indefinitely.
Section 2 (new section of KRS Chapter 237): (9) If a person restricted from purchasing or possessing a firearm under this section has a license to carry a concealed deadly weapon under KRS 237.110, the person's license shall be: (a) Suspended upon inclusion to the list; and (b) Reinstated upon removal from the list, unless: 1. The license has been revoked or suspended for another reason not described in this section; 2. The license has expired; or 3. The person has otherwise been restricted from possessing a firearm under state or federal law.
Section 2 (new section of KRS Chapter 237): (10) (a) It shall be unlawful for any person on the list to purchase, attempt to purchase, or possess a firearm. (b) Any person who violates this subsection is guilty of a Class B misdemeanor.
Section 2 (new section of KRS Chapter 237): (11) (a) It shall be unlawful for any person or entity required to perform a background check prior to transferring a firearm to transfer a firearm, either knowingly or due to a failure to perform the required background check, to any person on the list. (b) Any person who violates this subsection is guilty of a Class A misdemeanor for the first offense, and a Class D felony for a second or subsequent offense.
